title: [UX]: Fix unclean shutdown from ctrl-c with AR Fusion
body:
Fixes #35686

This PR addresses the `ImportError: sys.meta_path is None` encountered during shutdown when FlashInfer All-Reduce fusion is enabled.

### Description
When the Python interpreter shuts down, it clears modules and eventually sets `sys.meta_path` to `None`. If `AllReduceFusionWorkspace` objects are left to be cleaned up by the garbage collector at this stage, their `__del__` methods (in the `flashinfer` dependency) fail when they attempt to perform imports or use module-level variables.

By registering the cleanup function with `atexit`, we ensure that `destroy()` is called on these workspaces while the interpreter is still fully functional.

- Registered `destroy_fi_ar_workspace` with `atexit`.

title: perf(streaming): remove per-token heap allocation in SSE event classification
body:
## Motivation

In `apply_event_transformations_inplace` (the function that runs on every SSE event during streaming), the event type string was extracted from the JSON payload, used to compute a boolean, and then immediately cloned into an owned `String` so it could be used in a `match` statement after `parsed_data` was mutably borrowed. 

This meant every single token streamed from the model triggered a heap allocation, just to hold a copy of a string like `"response.output_text.delta"` for a few nanoseconds before it was dropped.

## Modifications

Replaced the `to_string()` workaround with a local `EventAction` enum. The event type is now read once in a scoped block, classified into the enum, and the borrow is released before any mutable access to `parsed_data`. The match at the bottom of the function operates on the zero-cost enum variant instead of the heap-allocated string. …[truncated]

## Purpose

Fixes the extreme TTFT regression (Noisy Neighbor effect) in the V1 engine when requests with high `n` (completions) and `logprobs` are co-scheduled.
